phase: PASS-32 ChatGPT version + A-0001 online verification (dtgsk-submission-v2.7 basis)
freeze_statement: Re-freeze after the author supplied the ChatGPT version and after A-0001 was closed by live retrieval of the venue's Instructions for Authors. No number, rank, p-value, test, standing or registered outcome changes; five of fifteen tracked files move, and both supplementary artifacts are byte-identical to the pass-31 mint. (1) ChatGPT is disclosed as version 5.5 in all four loci (the Use-of-GenAI statement, the Acknowledgments, the methods-level sentence and the cover letter). D-0032 had withheld a version because the author-recalled string was unverified; the author supplied it directly on 2026-08-01, and it is recorded in-source as an author attestation rather than a verified product string, because it was not checked against a product catalogue and this project does not name anything on inference. (2) A-0001, open since Phase 4, is CLOSED: the live MDPI Algorithms Instructions-for-Authors page was retrieved and read in full on 2026-08-01, and ten requirement rows are now verified against the live source instead of search snippets. Three consequences: MDPI's prescribed Acknowledgments sentence explicitly asks for '[tool name, version information]', which independently retires the D-0032 departure; the exemption wording confirms the original AG-0007 determination was sound in principle and lapsed on the facts rather than on a misreading; and two previously unrecorded submission-time actions surfaced (LaTeX must ship as a ZIP of all sources so the Editorial Office can recompile, and figures must be supplied in a single ZIP at preferably no less than 600 dpi). Also confirmed: no length or page cap exists on the page, so the CR-0021 caps are self-imposed discipline rather than a venue rule. (3) artifact_binding.csv, the only tracked governance file to move, no longer stamps 59 rows with a generator SHA that resolves nowhere in this repository; those cells now say what they are and point at the evidence-release manifest, which is the real provenance. Verification: all five artifacts byte-identical across two consecutive builds at the pinned epochs; hygiene, doc-consistency, provenance, citation controls, evidence bindings, artifact labels, cross-format parity, validate_docx on both documents, frozen analysis and citation_cff all green.
